raw.name: Omniscient
raw.description:
I got this ECOVACS DEEBOT X5 PRO OMNI vacuum for Christmas in 2024!
It's running 24/7 in the NNS house, with the latest available firmware.
That means it shouldn't have any vulnerabilities, right?

> [!NOTE]
> The flag is located at `/root/flag.txt`

> [!NOTE]
> This is a 0day challenge and we are hoping you keep th{is|ese} 0day{|s} to yourself until the vulnerabilit{y|ies} {is|are} patched.
